podcast.body: As the songwriter for Kansas, Kerry Livgren later revealed in a 2004 interview that this song was autobiographical, reflecting his personal "spiritual sojourn, looking for truth and meaning." He became a born-again Christian in late 1979 and subsequently became a Christian rock artist. "Wayward's Son was about his own spiritual journey. It's an autobiographical song, he said."
